title: 368. Palindrome Permutation

examples.explanation: All four letters differ, so any ordering leaves more than one character with an odd count.
Rearranged as "aba", it reads the same in both directions.
Rearranged as "racecar", it is a palindrome.

hints: A palindrome allows at most one character with an odd count.
Count characters with a set or map and check how many counts are odd.
